summary: Book the coast when the hotel is the reason for the trip, and the old town or the bay is what you do with the rest of the day.
body: Da Nang is Son Tra, Non Nuoc, and the resorts on My Khe and Vo Nguyen Giap. Hoi An is the Cua Dai beach hotels when you still want the old town at night. Phu Quoc is the west-coast sunset strip and the southern capes, including JW Marriott on Bai Khem and Premier Village on Ong Doi Cape. Ha Long is an overnight on the bay, not a day trip from Hanoi.

Mui Ne is one long resort road, with wind and kitesurf schools. Nha Trang is Tran Phu city sand, the Hon Tre island resorts, and Ninh Van Bay villas across the water. Rates are not listed here. Each name on those pages is on the operator’s own site.
